facts.fact: 1952 年 1 月末，外赫布里底（苏格兰西部）风暴；Saltwell 是 St. Magnus 湾沿岸的小社区
Clay Lockhart 抱着刚死去的妻子冲出屋：金发、苍白、深色从腰以下浸透白睡袍的血
facts.anchor: a body slumped and weighted in his arms: golden hair spilling from a pallid skull

facts.fact: 他在自家崖边挖了一小时，把她埋下；再回屋取出“两个更小的身体”——只是两块石头，小如园中南瓜，“还没长成”
facts.anchor: They were merely stones, tiny as garden squash, not yet ripe.

facts.fact: 邻居 Neil Hagdorn（脾气坏的牧羊人）听见地裂；众人以为是地震或巨人 Benandonner，但两者都不是
facts.anchor: Neil Hagdorn heard the cracking of the land

facts.fact: 天亮时白房子不见了，且不只是房子——整块地都不见了
facts.anchor: But it wasn’t merely the house that had vanished. The entire plot of land was missing.

facts.fact: 此后流传的版本：他的悲伤把地面整个裂开，房子连同四公顷土地崩离大陆、漂进大西洋
facts.anchor: causing the house and the four hectares of land it sat on to crack free of the mainland

facts.fact: 水手发誓看见岛上有 Clay 在游荡，不愿离开他埋葬妻儿的地方
facts.anchor: wandering the rocky shores of the island with no intention of calling out to the ships for help

facts.fact: 岛被称作 Saltwell Island：幽灵船、被诅咒的一堆土地；后来警告淡去，有人猜他跳崖自尽
facts.anchor: It’s known as Saltwell Island, a ghost ship, a fabled drifting island that should be avoided.

facts.fact: 数十年后，在异国的海岸线上，一个叫 Eleanor Mills 的女孩将登上这座岛：她因它被记住、也被遗忘
facts.anchor: A girl named Eleanor Mills, whose life would veer off course on a rainy, tempest night.
